title: Empirical Central Air Conditioner SEER2 vs SEER Energy Consumption and Cooling Degree Day (CDD) Benchmark Matrix
publisher: PowerLab Applied Clean Energy Research Group
standards_cited: AHRI Standard 210/240-2023 (Performance Rating of Unitary Air-Conditioning & Air-Source Heat Pump Equipment)
ASHRAE Standard 90.1 (Energy Standard for Buildings Except Low-Rise Residential Buildings)
U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) 10 CFR Part 430 Appendix M1 (SEER2 Testing Metrics)

methodology.seer2_definition: Seasonal Energy Efficiency Ratio 2 under DOE M1 external static pressure testing (0.50 in. w.g. vs legacy 0.10-0.20 in. w.g.).
methodology.hourly_power_at_95f: Electrical power demand in Watts during peak design outdoor dry-bulb temperature (95 deg F / 35 deg C).
methodology.annual_hours_moderate: 1,200 annual compressor runtime hours (typical DOE North/Mid-Atlantic climate).
methodology.annual_hours_hot_south: 2,100 annual compressor runtime hours (typical DOE South/Southeast cooling-dominated climate).
